title: docs: propose x402 Design Principles and XP (x402 Proposal) process
quote: Proposes a lightweight governance structure for evolving x402... modeled on MCPs Design Principles and SEP guidelines. Design Principles: a short set of TSC-owned north stars... XPs (x402 Proposals): the process for proposing protocol changes. It covers types (Standards, Extensions, Process, Informational), the workflow and statuses, the document format, a prototype requirement, sponsors, and conformance tests for Standards Track XPs.

title: Add UTA Trust Kit to third-party extensions
quote: UTA Trust Kit (Apache-2.0): Agent trust verification for x402 resource servers using Agent Trust Cards (ATC/1.0). Ed25519 card-verification middleware for Express and FastAPI... Live reference API... currently Base Sepolia testnet, settlement via the x402.org facilitator... Four real EIP-3009 settlements on-chain, receipts in the repo.

title: Announcing MCP support in Apigee hybrid: agentic tools that run in your own cluster
quote: MCP (Model Context Protocol) support in Apigee hybrid, available in Apigee hybrid 1.17.0... You create an MCP Discovery Proxy from an OpenAPI 3.0.x spec, and each operation becomes a tool... MCP request traffic stays inside your cluster... Each client sees and can call only the tools in its API product.
